source: Named synthetic quality commerce fixture; manually specified business questions and independent physical SQL.

cases.question: 按下单时间统计2026年第一季度的订单数量，所有订单状态都包括，只返回合计订单数。
cases.oracleSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM public.orders WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'

cases.question: 统计2026年第一季度按下单时间归属的下单金额合计，单位元，包含全部订单状态；使用订单记录金额，不扣退款，不从订单明细重建。
cases.oracleSql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS ordered_amount FROM public.orders WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'

cases.question: 2026年1月全部状态订单的平均订单金额是多少？按下单时间统计，单位元，金额为空的订单不填零，不扣退款。只返回平均值。
cases.oracleSql: SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_order_amount FROM public.orders WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01'

cases.question: 按下单月份列出2026年第一季度每个月的订单数量，不筛选订单状态，按月份从早到晚排列。
cases.oracleSql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month',ordered_at) AS ordered_at_month,COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM public.orders WHERE ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month',ordered_at)

cases.question: 2026年2月的取消订单数量是多少？按下单时间统计，仅包含状态为已取消的订单，只返回合计数量。
cases.oracleSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_order_count FROM public.orders WHERE status='CANCELLED' AND ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01' AND ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01'

cases.question: 按支付记录时间统计2026年第一季度的已支付订单数量，已退款但曾支付的订单也算，不改为按下单时间统计，只返回合计数量。
cases.oracleSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS paid_order_count FROM public.orders WHERE status IN ('PAID','REFUNDED') AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'

cases.question: 按成功退款时间统计2026年第一季度的成功退款次数，只算SUCCESS的退款记录；同一订单多次成功退款分别计数，不按订单去重。返回合计次数。
cases.oracleSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS successful_refund_count FROM public.refunds WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND refunded_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND refunded_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'

cases.question: 按成功退款时间统计2026年第一季度的成功退款订单数，只算SUCCESS；同一订单在所选期内有多笔成功退款也只计一单。返回合计订单数，不使用订单下单时间筛选。
cases.oracleSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS successful_refund_order_count FROM public.refunds WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND refunded_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND refunded_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
